prompt: When creating a project, if the permissions/authorization setup fails after the project row has already been written, the row is left orphaned: it exists in the database with no owner permissions, and its name stays taken so a retry with the same name conflicts. Make creation undo the partial write when the permissions step fails. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: project create authz failure orphaned row
rollback project row permissions setup failed
duplicate name after failed project create
_subject: Clean up project row after authz create failure
